rules.parameter: A loan is ineligible if any scheduled payment is more than 30 days past due at the cut-off date. Up to and including 30 days past due passes.
rules.quote: Delinquency. No scheduled payment on the Receivable is more than 30 days past due.

rules.parameter: A loan that has been charged off, or whose vehicle has been repossessed, is ineligible.
rules.quote: Status. The Receivable has not been charged off and the related Financed Vehicle has not been repossessed.

rules.parameter: The original term must be 84 months or less.
rules.quote: Term. The original term of the Receivable is 84 months or less.

rules.parameter: The obligor's FICO score at origination must be 540 or higher.
rules.quote: Credit score. The Obligor's FICO score at origination is 540 or higher.

rules.parameter: The outstanding balance must not exceed US$75,000.
rules.quote: Balance. The Outstanding Balance of the Receivable does not exceed US$75,000.

rules.parameter: The obligor's billing address must be in one of the fifty US states or the District of Columbia. The tape has obligor_state, not a separate billing address field; obligor_state is used as the closest field.
rules.quote: Location. The Obligor's billing address is in one of the fifty states of the United States or the District of Columbia.

rules.parameter: The obligor's billing address must not be in a Restricted Jurisdiction. The list of Restricted Jurisdictions is not in the material provided, so the test cannot be populated until that definition is obtained.
rules.quote: Restricted Jurisdictions. The Obligor's billing address is not in a Restricted Jurisdiction.

rules.parameter: The loan may have been modified at most once since origination.
rules.quote: Modifications. The terms of the Receivable have been modified no more than once since origination.

rules.parameter: The APR must be between 6.00% and 29.99%, both inclusive.
rules.quote: Annual percentage rate. The annual percentage rate of the Receivable is not less than 6.00% and not more than 29.99%.

rules.parameter: The vehicle's model year must be no more than ten years before the year the loan was originated (compare model_year with the year of origination_date).
rules.quote: Vehicle age. The model year of the Financed Vehicle is no more than ten years before the year of origination of the Receivable.

rules.parameter: The obligor must have made at least one scheduled payment.
rules.quote: Seasoning. The Obligor has made at least one scheduled payment on the Receivable.

rules.parameter: The vehicle's VIN must not appear on any other loan in the pool; a repeated VIN suggests the car was pledged twice.
rules.quote: Unique collateral. The Financed Vehicle is identified by a Vehicle Identification Number that appears on no other Receivable in the Pool.

rules.parameter: Loans to obligors billed in any one state may make up at most 20% of the Eligible Pool Balance; any excess is an excess concentration.
rules.quote: Obligors with a billing address in any one state

rules.parameter: Loans originated by any one dealer may make up at most 5% of the Eligible Pool Balance. Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name count as one dealer.
rules.quote: Receivables originated by any one Dealer, treating Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name as one Dealer

rules.parameter: Loans with an original term of more than 72 months (strictly greater than 72) may make up at most 25% of the Eligible Pool Balance.
rules.quote: Receivables with an original term of more than 72 months

rules.parameter: Loans secured by used vehicles may make up at most 70% of the Eligible Pool Balance.
rules.quote: Receivables secured by used Financed Vehicles

rules.clause: Schedule 2, row 5 (added by Amendment No. 1, Section 2(b))
rules.parameter: From 1 March 2026, loans whose obligor's FICO score at origination is below 600 (strictly less than 600) may make up at most 35% of the Eligible Pool Balance. Added by Amendment No. 1; it applies to Borrowing Base Certificates for Collection Periods ending on or after 1 March 2026, and the Amendment itself takes effect only once the conditions in its Section 3 are met.

nodes.quote: "Pool Receivable" means each Receivable that is included in the Pool at the time of determination, and that has not been released from the Collateral in accordance with Section 3.3
"Pool" means, at any time, the aggregate of all Receivables then owned by the Borrower and pledged to the Administrative Agent as Collateral under the Security Agreement.
"Receivable" means any retail installment sale contract or installment loan agreement, whether or not evidenced by a promissory note or electronic record, that is originated
"Eligible Receivable" means, on any date of determination, a Pool Receivable that satisfies each of the criteria set out in Schedule 1 on that date.

resolved.rule: A Pool Receivable that meets every criterion in Schedule 1

nodes.quote: A Receivable satisfies this Schedule 1 on a date of determination only if, on that date, each of the following is true.

resolved.rule: E1: days_past_due <= 30; E2: status not in excluded_statuses; E3: original_term <= 84; E4: fico >= 540; E5: current_balance <= 75,000; E6: obligor_state in us_states; E7: obligor_state not in schedule_4; E8: modification_count <= 1; E9: 6.00 <= apr <= 29.99; E10: year(origination_date) - model_year <= 10; E11: payments_made >= 1; E12: vin appears once in the tape

nodes.quote: "Restricted Jurisdiction" means each state, territory or other jurisdiction listed in Schedule 4.
"Vehicle Identification Number" means, for a Financed Vehicle, the unique seventeen-character identification number assigned to that vehicle by its manufacturer
"Financed Vehicle" means an automobile, light truck, sport utility vehicle, van or motorcycle, together with all accessions to it, that secures the payment obligations of an Obligor
"Obligor" means, with respect to any Receivable, each Person obligated to make payments under that Receivable, including any co-signer or guarantor of that Receivable.
"Dealer" means any motor vehicle dealer that originated a Receivable, or that sold the related Financed Vehicle to the related Obligor and assigned the related Receivable to
"Collection Period" means each calendar month. "Collections" means, with respect to any Receivable, all cash collections
"Delinquency Ratio" means, for any Collection Period, the percentage equal to (a) the aggregate Outstanding Balance of Pool Receivables that are 60 or more days past due

resolved.rule: Outstanding Balance 60 or more days past due / Outstanding Balance of all Pool Receivables, both excluding Defaulted Receivables that have been charged off
